name: Jagemann Precision Plastics
old_description: Precision Plastics specializes in insert molding that combines discrete components, including metal and plastics into a single composite piece. This process has brought improvements to the automotive, appliance, solar and medical markets and results in saving customers assembly time, labor and money. Jagemann’s over molding is an efficient process for producing automotive components, solar connectors and electrical components resulting in both time and monetary savings.
about:
Jagemann Precision Plastics operates in Murfreesboro, Tennessee, as a division of Jagemann Stamping Co., a fourth-generation family-owned business founded in 1946 by William P. Jagemann, Sr. in Manitowoc, Wisconsin. The division was established to specialize in insert molding and over molding, combining metal and plastic components into single composite pieces.

The company focuses on insert molding and over molding processes for automotive components, solar connectors, and electrical parts. A 2015 expansion added 30,000 square feet and up to 90 jobs at the Murfreesboro facility, complementing the parent company’s 200,000-square-foot plant in Manitowoc with more than 70 presses ranging from 15 to 700 tons. In-house tooling design, build, and maintenance support deep draw stamping, fineblanking, and progressive die stamping, while secondary operations such as deburring, pressure testing, washing, and machining are performed under one roof.

Jagemann Precision Plastics serves the automotive, appliance, solar, and medical markets, along with broader industrial, consumer, and electrical manufacturing sectors. Customers include Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs seeking to reduce assembly time, labor, and cost through integrated metal-plastic components.

The company emphasizes a collaborative, engineering-driven approach, with leadership citing in-house tooling, rapid response, and a quality system certified to ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 as key differentiators. The integrated setup aims to eliminate handoffs, maintain tight process control, and deliver consistent high-volume production.
